data.body: COORDINATION: dbbc-cf67-8cfc-4b4d (Stateful re-review with CI/local parity, arbitration, and tier-decoupling) is approved and ready for preplanning. Its DefenseStore interface ships with load_for_region(region_files) from day 1 (no-op default) so this epic's Strategy E (region-split in HUGE workflow) can activate region-aware defense loading without a future schema migration.
